messages.subject: Figure 4 in Dupin et al. 2017
parts:
Dear Nick,

I have seen the Figure 4 in Dupin et al. 2017 (https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/epdf/10.1111/jbi.12898). I wonder if there is an available script to summary the BSM analyses the same way that in this figure.

Thanks!

Marcial.

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Figure 4 in Dupin et al. 2017
parts:
Hi! The BSM script produces tables with mean counts and SDs, but these are text files. I think the actual figure was done manually.  Julia Dupin did the actual figure there, so you could email her if you want to double-check.

Cheers!
